title: Grateful Dead Live at International Speedway on 1969-12-28
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > USB > WaveLab > CD Wave > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Excellent sound quality captures a solid but not spectacular performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its great, almost flawless audio fidelity, earning a perfect score for sound. The show itself is deemed good—enjoyable and well‑executed—but not among the Dead's top performances, resulting in an overall four‑star rating. Listeners can expect clear mix with no notable technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewer rates sound quality at 5 stars and the performance at 4 stars; weighted average (70% show, 30% recording) yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great sound quality, crisp and clear with no reported issues.
